ITEM.PTXT: The meter computer receives the vehicle speed signal (CAN communication) from the skid control computer, calculates the distance traveled data, and displays the distance traveled on the multi-information display.

When the odo/trip select switch operation signal is input to the meter computer, the display switches odometer → trip meter A → trip meter B → odometer; when the meter computer receives the reset operation signal of the odo/trip select switch, it returns the trip meter distance display to 0.0km.
The odometer data is retained by the meter computer; the odometer value is stored using a non-volatile memory IC and is retained even after the +B power is turned OFF.
A memory IC that continues to retain data even when power is not supplied
